hero.title: Let's talk about your site.
hero.lede: The quickest way to start is a phone call or a message. Tell us where the site is, what the survey is for and which documents you have.

form.lede: Fill in the form and we will prepare a WhatsApp message with your details. Nothing is sent from this website — you review the message and send it yourself.

errors.serviceRequired: Choose a service, or select “Other or not sure”.

success.title: Your message is ready
success.text: WhatsApp should open in a new tab with the message filled in. It is not sent until you press send in WhatsApp. If WhatsApp did not open, copy the message and send it by Telegram or call {{phone}}.
